entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The city plane where it is autumn and the story plays out in darkness like a film noir.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Elder dragon slowly influencing Ravnica and warping it to his needs.

entities.name: Ravnican guilds
entities.description: Guilds, including Selesnya, Boros, Golgari, Izzet and Dimir, that fight internally over being pulled toward or away from Bolas's influence.

events.summary: The story gears up for the final showdown with Nicol Bolas as he tries to slowly influence and warp Ravnica.
